items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, the first professional band I heard was Jimmie Lunceford. When I heard the sound of that trumpet section, that changed my life.

ctx.x: [Laughs] Okay. So, that must’ve been the first time you heard a professional jazz band live, is that correct?
No, the first professional band I heard was Jimmie Lunceford. When I heard the sound of that trumpet section, that changed my life.
Do you remember when they played and what year that was?
